addNode.title: Add another machine (optional)
addNode.lead: This panel manages the machine it was installed on. You can create websites, databases and certificates there without adding a second machine.
addNode.toggleShow: Show how to add a machine
addNode.step1: Mint a single-use enrolment token on the Add Server screen.
addNode.step2: Install the agent on the new machine and start it with the panel URL and that token.
addNode.step3: The agent generates its own key, collects a certificate from the panel, and appears in this list.
addNode.optionalNote: Clustering and HA are an optional layer for several machines: set them up when you need to spread load or fail over, not before. A single machine runs every hosting feature on its own.

panelHost.title: Panel host
panelHost.body: This panel manages the machine it runs on. That machine has not been registered as a managed node yet, so its details are not available. Check again in a moment; if it stays this way, the local agent is not reporting.
panelHost.unavailableReason: Not available: the panel host has not been registered as a managed node yet, so nothing has reported this figure.

scope.singleNodeHint: This panel manages one machine, so the action runs there.

detail.title: Server
detail.loadFailed: This server could not be read
detail.loadFailedBody: The panel could not read this machine. Try again; if it keeps failing, the API is not answering.
detail.metricsFailed: The stored sample for this machine could not be read
detail.sampleFailed: The live reading for this machine could not be read
detail.countersNote: The network figures above are counters: bytes since the machine last booted, not traffic per second.

notFound.title: No such server
notFound.body: Nothing with this identifier belongs to your account. It may have been removed, or the link may point at a machine on another account - the panel answers both the same way on purpose, so a node id cannot be probed for existence.

denied.title: You may not read this server
denied.body: Your account does not carry the "server" permission, which every route under /servers requires. Ask an administrator to grant it.

neverReported.title: This machine has never reported
neverReported.body: No sample has ever arrived from it, so every live figure below is unavailable rather than zero. Check that the agent is installed, running, and able to reach this panel.

stale.title: These figures are old
stale.body: The last reading was taken {when}. What you see is what was measured then, not what the machine is doing now.

monitoringDenied.title: Live figures are not available to your account
monitoringDenied.body: The collector's endpoints carry the "monitoring" permission, which your account does not have. The machine's own details below are unaffected.

appStore.title: App Store
appStore.chooseVersionLead: Pick the version to install. Each one names the packages it hands the package manager and the repository they come from.
appStore.fixedVersionLead: {distribution} publishes one version of {app}, so there is nothing to choose. The panel installs what your distribution ships rather than offering a list it cannot deliver.
appStore.noRepositoryAdded: No repository is added to this host.
appStore.addsRepositoryLead: Installing this version adds {repository} to this host first. Every step is listed in the plan before anything runs, and the job removes what it wrote if the repository will not load.
appStore.sideBySideHint: This version coexists with the others; installing it replaces nothing.
appStore.requiresComposer: Installed with Composer, not from an archive
appStore.webAppLead: A PHP application deployed into a website, not a package. The panel lists what it needs so you can see whether this host is ready.
appStore.forbiddenTitle: This screen is for platform operators only
appStore.forbiddenBody: The App Store installs and removes software on the shared host, so it is restricted to the platform operators who run this machine rather than to a tenant's own administrators. Installing or removing a web server, a database or a PHP version here would affect every site on this server, not only yours. Ask whoever operates this panel if you need software installed.

docker.title: Docker
docker.subtitle: Containers, images, networks and volumes on this host.
docker.scopeNoticeTitle: You see only your own containers
docker.scopeNoticeBody: This host is shared. Every list on this screen is limited to the containers, images, networks, volumes and Compose projects belonging to your account, and anything created outside the panel belongs to nobody and is not shown.
docker.paneContainers: Your containers on this host, running or not.
docker.paneImages: The images your account uses on this host, with the containers built from each.
docker.paneNetworks: Your Docker networks, with what is attached to each.
docker.paneVolumes: Your named volumes, with the containers that mount each.
docker.paneCompose: Your multi-container projects, from the labels Compose writes and from your project directory.
docker.paneOverview: What your account has on this host and how much of it can be freed.
